title: Benchmark run manifest
description: The manifest at the root of every result bundle. Transcribed from benchmarks.md section 6, which is authoritative. This schema is a contract frozen at R0 (r0-architecture.md section 5): every later result is compared against R0's, so the schema has to survive. Adding a field is a compatible change; renaming or removing one is not, and invalidates comparison against archived bundles.

release.description: The release this run belongs to.

benchmark.description: Gate identifier from the registry in gates.md section 4.

tier.description: T1 nightly CI, T2 weekly route, T3 gate protocol (benchmarks.md section 2).

status.description: Per ci.md section 4. UNAVAILABLE is never a pass: a sleeping or busy runner reports UNAVAILABLE with its reason, and the report shows the last successful result together with its age.

status_reason.description: Required in spirit whenever status is UNAVAILABLE or NOT_IMPLEMENTED: why, in words. A NOT_IMPLEMENTED row also carries the release by which it must clear.

not_implemented_clears_by.description: For NOT_IMPLEMENTED rows: the release by which this must become PASS. Nothing may remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED past its date without a recorded schedule event.

source_revision.description: Exact git revision of the engine under test.

generator_seed.description: Procedural generator seed (D8), null when the generator was not used.

shader_hash.description: Hash over the compiled shader set, wired in at R0 (r0-architecture.md section 4).

slang_version.description: Pinned, per ci/pins.json. Gate B0.4 requires this, clusterlod_version and meshoptimizer_version to be present in EVERY manifest.

feature_set_release.description: Which release's feature set the backend under test implements. Metal trails Vulkan by one release by design (D2).

profile_a_trails_by_releases.description: How far Profile A is behind Profile L in feature coverage. Displayed on the report page every day, because 'one release behind' degrades into 'deferred' unless something shows the gap (ci.md section 7).

profile.description: L is the Linux/NVIDIA laptop, A the Apple Silicon laptop (architecture.md section 2).

backend.description: The backend exercised. cpu-reference and indexed-oracle are the comparison targets for a Vulkan-only new-feature fixture.

machine_role.description: Resolved from ci/machines.json by 'xmake ci-machine'. 'qualification' is the hardware named in architecture.md section 2; 'development' is any other box, where runs are mock. An unregistered machine defaults to 'development', because defaulting the other way would let an unknown machine quietly produce evidence.

evidence_eligible.description: Whether this bundle may be archived as evidence behind a published claim. False on a development machine. A T3 gate bundle with this false is rejected by 'xmake ci-bundle': gate bundles are the evidence behind the release report and they outlive the machines that produced them (ci.md section 7).

machine_manifest.description: Path to, or content hash of, the machine manifest captured by 'xmake ci-machine'.

gpu_power_limit_w.description: Laptop results are valid for the recorded power and display configuration only.

memory_profile.description: normal 1024 MiB, stress 512 MiB, comfort 2048 MiB (architecture.md section 7). comfort is diagnostic only.

resolution.description: Render buffer in pixels, not the physical panel. Presentation scaling is recorded separately in the machine manifest.

raster_path.description: mesh_shader is primary from R2 (D3b); indexed_indirect is kept permanently as oracle and fallback; compute exists only if the D6 experiment reopened, which defaults to no.

mode.description: benchmarks.md section 2. Do not label a run storage-cold unless that state was actually established; if it cannot be, report it unavailable.

command.description: The actual command line that produced this bundle. benchmarks.md section 6: 'The manifest records the actual command'.
